doc: world/feed-ui.md is canonical for behavior + copy. This file is the machine-readable mirror: spectator-feed event schema, event vocabulary, and the demo seed set used by feed.html. The spectator feed is FREE forever (design §5) — it is the product's top of funnel, never metered.

event_schema.who: optional character id (C1–C8, A01–A20) or player handle on request events
event_schema.text: display text — surface-level only; never quotes interiors of homes, never secrets
event_schema.status: request events only: one of request_status
event_schema.attrs: optional: { surge, credits, compensated_cr } for transparency lines

event_kinds: a named character changes venue (arrivals/departures — public routine only)
crowd-level note: fills, empties, line out the door
sky changes — including player-called weather, attributed
a player request lifecycle event (attributed — design §5 public request feed)
owner/admin action, always attributed, always with compensation note
Mission Unfiltered blog post — the blog is public; the author is a secret and never named
public registry events: move-in, listing posted/filled (never terms beyond posted rent)
honest-empty marker for dead dayparts — the feed may go quiet and says so
display_rules: surface-only: feed text is what a camera on the street could verify — no thoughts, no dialogue, no home interiors
homes render as 'home'/'headed home' — residential interiors are never a feed surface
secrets/drama seeds cannot appear: they are absent from the feed schema (structural, not filtered)
request text shown verbatim only after the §11 screen passes; denied text is never displayed
admin actions always carry compensation detail when players were affected
Mission Unfiltered posts carry no author — the author is a C1 secret and the feed does not speculate
viewer counts and timestamps are honest — no inflated social proof (no dark patterns)
